answer.reason: The verses state that Jeduthun was appointed with Heman to give thanks and sound instruments before the tabernacle, and that David set his sons apart to prophesy with harps.

clauses.english: was appointed with Heman to give thanks to the LORD with trumpets, cymbals and instruments of God
clauses.quote: And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals

clauses.english: prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and praise the LORD, with his sons set apart for the service by David
clauses.quote: under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp

doubts: 1CH 9:16 and NEH 11:17 name Jeduthun only in genealogies, so they were left out.
1CH 16:38, 2CH 5:12, 2CH 29:14 and 2CH 35:15 give only relations or lists, so they were not used for clauses, though 1CH 16:42 could be read as saying his sons were porters.
The summary already names him as prophet to David, so the second clause rests on the prophesying with a harp rather than the office.
